trace.workload: Llama 3.2 1B decode, batch 1, context 1024, weights int4, KV int8

points.design: cv32e20 @ 100 MHz, onetoM bus, 2x32 KiB, no accelerator, hyperram, ihp-sg13g2
points.title: Start from a bare microcontroller
points.body: A CV32E20 at 100 MHz with two 32 KiB banks on IHP 130 nm. The CPU does every multiply itself, and the 642 MiB of weights and KV cache do not fit in a 64 MiB HyperRAM.

points.design: cv32e20 @ 200 MHz, onetoM bus, 2x32 KiB, no accelerator, lpddr2-x32, generic-65nm
points.title: Move to 65 nm, 200 MHz and LPDDR2
points.body: A newer node allows faster clocks and memory interfaces at lower energy. Before this step 100% of the time went to compute.
points.delta: 0.0036 to 0.019 tokens per second, 1.11e+03 to 410 mJ per token, 4.97 to 3.13 mm², now buildable

points.design: cv32e20 @ 200 MHz, NtoM bus, 2x32 KiB + 2x16 KiB interleaved, gemv 4x8 int8, 2 ports, lpddr2-x32, generic-65nm
points.title: Add a GEMV engine
points.body: Matrix multiplies dominate and the CPU does them one MAC at a time. Before this step 100% of the time went to compute.
points.delta: 0.019 to 1.70 tokens per second, 410 to 86.5 mJ per token, 3.13 to 3.69 mm²

points.design: cv32e20 @ 400 MHz, NtoM bus, 2x32 KiB + 2x16 KiB interleaved, gemv 4x8 int8, 2 ports, lpddr4x-x32, generic-28nm
points.title: Move to 28 nm, 400 MHz and LPDDR4X
points.body: A newer node allows faster clocks and memory interfaces at lower energy. Before this step 75% of the time went to the accelerator's ports.
points.delta: 1.70 to 3.30 tokens per second, 86.5 to 29.1 mJ per token, 3.69 to 2.50 mm²

points.design: cv32e20 @ 800 MHz, NtoM bus, 2x32 KiB + 2x16 KiB interleaved, gemv 4x8 int8, 2 ports, lpddr4x-x32, generic-16nm
points.title: Move to 16 nm, 800 MHz
points.body: A newer node allows faster clocks and memory interfaces at lower energy. Before this step 76% of the time went to the accelerator's ports.
points.delta: 3.30 to 6.18 tokens per second, 29.1 to 28 mJ per token, 2.50 to 1.37 mm², meets every target

points.design: cv32e20 @ 800 MHz, NtoM bus, 2x32 KiB + 2x16 KiB interleaved, gemv 4x8 int8, 2 ports, lpddr5-x16, generic-16nm
points.title: Switch to LPDDR5
points.body: A slower interface can be cheaper in area and energy per bit. Before this step 78% of the time went to the accelerator's ports.
points.delta: throughput unchanged at 6.18 tokens per second, 28 to 22.5 mJ per token, 1.37 to 1.03 mm²

points.design: cv32e20 @ 800 MHz, NtoM bus, 2x16 KiB + 2x16 KiB interleaved, gemv 4x8 int8, 2 ports, lpddr5-x16, generic-16nm
points.title: Make the banks 16 KiB
points.body: Unused SRAM costs area and leakage. Before this step 78% of the time went to the accelerator's ports.
points.delta: throughput unchanged at 6.17 tokens per second, 1.03 to 1.00 mm²
points.final: No single change lowers the energy further, so the agent stops with a 4 x 8 GEMV engine next to a CV32E20 at 800 MHz in 16 nm, fed by LPDDR5: 6.17 tokens per second at 22.6 mJ per token in 1.00 mm². Its weights now arrive as fast as the accelerator's ports take them in, so more ports would raise the token rate but not lower the energy per token.
